what_is_available: A complete JDK 21 toolchain is installed and its absolute paths and versions are recorded above. What is missing is only the operator-supplied Bouncy Castle provider, PKIX and util JARs and their checksum file. Without them there is no permitted CMS implementation on this machine that is materially independent of OpenSSL.
why_not_substituted: Java's own CMS support is not a materially independent verifier for this purpose and no substitute library may be downloaded: the build is offline by instruction and by policy. Building a verifier against a different library than the one whose provenance the operator recorded would also break the checksum chain that makes the verifier admissible.
